meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 先派子代理查找并阅读相关文档，确认真实存在的 API，再产出一份分阶段实施计划，含文档引用、验证清单和禁止事项。
howto.when: 当你要求规划某个功能、任务或分多步的实现时触发，尤其在执行前的规划场景。

say.text: 帮我为这个新功能制定分阶段实施计划
say.note: 先做文档发现，再逐阶段输出计划

say.text: 动手写代码前，先规划一下这个任务
say.note: 第一阶段先查文档与可用 API

say.text: 把这份需求拆成可逐个执行的阶段计划
say.note: 每阶段带文档引用与验证清单

howto.what_en: Claude first sends subagents to find and read the relevant docs, confirms which APIs actually exist, then produces a phased implementation plan with doc references, verification checklists, and anti-pattern guards.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

say_en.text: Plan a phased implementation for this feature
say_en.note: Runs doc discovery first, then writes the plan

say_en.text: Before coding, make a plan for this task
say_en.note: Phase 0 gathers docs before any steps

say_en.text: Split this requirement into executable phases
say_en.note: Each phase cites docs and a verify checklist
